0.question: Where is Imperial Middle East located?
0.answer: Imperial Middle East is based in M45, Mussafah, Abu Dhabi, UAE. Contact the team before visiting to confirm stock, pack size, payment and collection readiness.

1.question: Does Imperial Middle East serve all seven Emirates?
1.answer: Yes. Imperial supports customers and projects in Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Sharjah, Ajman, Umm Al Quwain, Ras Al Khaimah and Fujairah. Delivery, site visits and schedules are confirmed according to the requirement and location.

2.question: Where can I find TDS and SDS documents?
2.answer: Applicable documents appear on the product page under Documents when available. Website copy is a purchasing guide — the latest manufacturer TDS, SDS and project specification control technical use.

3.question: Can I upload a BOQ for pricing?
3.answer: Yes. Upload an Excel file, PDF, specification, product schedule or material list through Request a Quote. Include the project name, Emirate, required date and contact details.

Pages.aboutSummary: Imperial Middle East is a building materials and construction products supplier based in Mussafah, Abu Dhabi. Since 2013, the company has supported contractors, project teams, maintenance businesses, workshops and individual buyers in Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Sharjah, Ajman, Umm Al Quwain, Ras Al Khaimah and Fujairah.
Pages.aboutRange: Our range supports waterproofing, tile installation, concrete repair, sealing, bonding, flooring, coatings, fixings, tools, cleaning and site safety. Customers can request product documents, material recommendations, suitable site visits, project quotations, trade support and coordinated UAE delivery.
Pages.mission: To help UAE customers source suitable construction and industrial products with clear information, responsive service and dependable project coordination.
Pages.vision: To become the UAE's most useful Abu Dhabi-based construction-material destination, recognised for product depth, technical clarity and project support.
